subject.title: feat(dashboard): add unlisted OpenClaw Bay demo

question: Should the existing public ClawSweeper dashboard Worker host this unlisted OpenClaw Bay experiment and its durable terminal-state contract?
rationale: The feature aligns with the dashboard direction in VISION.md, but tests cannot decide whether the project should permanently own this public experimental route, static payload, and presentation-state behavior.

options.title: Sponsor the hosted experiment
options.body: Keep `/bay-demo` unlisted on the existing Worker after stronger real-browser proof confirms its interactions and network boundary.

options.title: Keep the prototype outside production
options.body: Pause or close the PR and retain the work as local design exploration without adding the hosted route and persistence contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the hosted experiment
recommendation.body: Keep `/bay-demo` unlisted on the existing Worker after stronger real-browser proof confirms its interactions and network boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The current dashboard/status Worker and most of its recent operational behavior trace to his commits, making him the strongest available owner for the hosting decision.
